title: Libraries and references
summary: Guide to the outside libraries and reference sources UI System projects use (DiceBear, anime.js, Hugeicons, React Bits, Untitled UI, Mobbin, Appllama) and how each is wired to the theme.
notes: No frontmatter or filename convention. Usage-guide structure (library table, how-to steps, code snippets) with no Status/Decision/Consequences, user stories or API contracts. Contains embedded rules worth extracting as constraints by the synthesizer: Hugeicons only for icons, DiceBear for people without photos (never stock or AI faces), anime.js must respect config.motion and reduced motion, React Bits recolored with --uis-* and 4.5:1 contrast, one effect per section, UI System components before Untitled UI, search Mobbin for 5-10 references and cite links before a new screen, dashboard-first scope. These library choices are also stated in CLAUDE.md as owner rules. External URLs only, no internal doc links. Output filename uses path-based slug instead of SHA-256 hash: no hashing tool available, matching sibling convention.
